speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Advances in technology, particularly low-cost, unmanned, and dual-use systems, are redefining warfare.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will make judicious decisions on what to buy, build, or co-develop with partners.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: By strengthening indigenous capacities and developing unique value propositions, we will position ourselves as a partner of choice in capability building, technology innovation, and supply chain resilience.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The SAF will deploy service personnel more effectively, and adopt technologies that complement and amplify their strengths.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will continue to ensure that the training is rigorous, realistic and safe.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Every Singaporean plays a vital role in our defence.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: MINDEF will expand opportunities for volunteers of all ages, skillsets and backgrounds to contribute to national defence.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Through Total Defence, we will better prepare Singaporeans for crises and disruptions, including through partnerships with government agencies, businesses and community groups, to uphold our collective resilience across generations.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: MINDEF will refresh its approach to National Education, to deepen our public’s understanding of the changing external environment and Singapore’s fundamental realities, foster public support for national priorities and strengthen commitment to defence and NS.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: MINDEF and the SAF will enhance strategic relevance, strengthen military readiness and build whole-of-nation resilience to ensure Singapore’s continued peace, security and success in a changing world.
